title: SID MEDICOS studies demonstrate LemonBottle benefits for cellulite appearance, hydration and radiance
summary: Global beauty and aesthetics company SID MEDICOS has completed clinical studies on three key products from its LemonBottle brand, demonstrating product-specific skin benefits and low irritation potential

extraction.key_fact: 글로벌 뷰티 에스테틱 기업 에스아이디메디코스가 레몬보틀 브랜드의 핵심 제품들에 대한 임상 연구를 완료해 피부 효능과 저자극성을 입증했다.
